5. Approved nurse Hi Heeya: additional FACE-detail reference for the SAME Hi Heeya only. Reinforce her recognizable eye shape, nose, lips and face proportions without copying the nurse outfit, short hairstyle or scene.

Mechanical mounts remain visible at the sides and rear. Do not cover her face, chest, white apron or waist with weapon parts. The costume remains the main silhouette in the center, not armor. Parallel rails and barrel bundles stay parallel in perspective. Show plausible braces and grip connections; five fingers per visible hand, clean wrist and forearm anatomy. ENVIRONMENT / LIGHT: A new grand gothic palace courtyard at cool blue dusk after battle, softly painted receding towers and broken stone in the background, a few restrained warm lights and red weapon-core accents. The background supports the character and stays lower in contrast. Gentle frontal fill makes Hi Heeya's face and dark dress readable, subtle cool rim light separates the full rig. No huge moon or luminous magic circle. No copying the exact camera angle, broken city layout, or cape shape of the outfit reference.

QUALITY: Natural continuous individual hair flow from roots to tips, soft volume and fine flyaways; no layered rigid hair plates, striped highlights or plastic hair. Naturally connected adult proportions; not chibi, not doll anatomy, not photographic skin or 3D rendering. Finished premium character illustration with rich but disciplined material separation. Black satin, white lace, sheer stockings and metal must read as distinct materials. Preserve facial identity through the change of scene and pose.
NO letters, names, ranks, numbers, emblems with text, logos, watermark, signature, UI, card border or frame. No collage seams or split panels. Exact 2:3 portrait, minimum native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, opaque fully illustrated background.
